packageRules.description: VanillaBP and the adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up. The Camunda 7 adapter of the two migration modules is one of them.

CIB seven publishes only its minors on Maven Central. This adapter pins one minor and carries it in its own version (decision 3 in DECISIONS.md), so a patch which reaches Maven Central comes in on its own.

A new CIB seven minor needs a person: it needs a database upgrade, the adapter uses engine classes under '.impl.', the minor is part of the adapter version, and the recipe rewrite/vanillabp-cibseven.yml pins the same minor. So it comes as a pull request to look at, and it is a story of its own.
